visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a tight close-up on a young woman's eyes and nose; she has smooth, neutral skin and her eyes are closed. A hand enters the frame from the left side holding a circular white cotton pad and wipes the makeup off her right eye area. A male creator with dark hair and a black t-shirt is visible in a small overlay at the bottom left, looking shocked with his mouth open and hands raised near his face in a gesture of amazement. The background behind the model is a plain, dimly lit studio wall with soft, even lighting. (2) After the wipe, deep, dark purple and brown circles are revealed under the woman's right eye. The creator points at his own face, explaining the situation while the screen shows a separate demonstration of someone applying light-colored concealer with their finger incorrectly. The woman's face remains static and centered as a canvas for the makeup demonstration. The background is a solid, neutral gray-beige tone that provides high contrast for the skin details. (3) The creator introduces a makeup palette with four sections; a hand is seen mixing a salmon-pink cream from the 'Ruby' palette on the back of another hand using a small metal spatula. Then, a small, precision brush is used to apply the mixture carefully under the model's eye. The creator continues to gesture enthusiastically in his corner, wearing a silver ring on his finger. The bright studio lighting highlights the creamy texture of the product. (4) A second step involves mixing yellow and orange shades from the same palette. A larger, angled brush is used to tap the product onto the model's lower eyelid and upper cheek area. The creator puts a finger to his lips in a secretive 'shhh' gesture, suggesting a professional secret. White arrows appear on the screen to highlight the specific areas of the face being discussed. (5) The creator presents a skin-tone concealer palette. A flat brush is used to blend the product over the previously corrected areas on the model's face. The model's skin begins to look flawlessly even as the darkness disappears. The creator uses both hands to frame his face, emphasizing the dramatic change. A white sponge is used to gently dab the area for final blending. (6) Finally, a large, fluffy brush dips into a container of translucent powder and sets the makeup on the model's face. The video concludes with a split-screen 'Before' and 'After' comparison showing the dramatic difference in eye brightness. The model holds two makeup palettes in front of her face while the creator smiles warmly, crossing his arms and leaning toward the camera in his overlay against a neutral background.
